title: Gerente de Testes
description:
Esta posição é responsável pela supervisão de testes de ponta a ponta, incluindo execução da estratégia, gerenciamento de recursos, coordenação com as partes interessadas, gerenciamento de riscos e relatórios de progresso.

O Gerente de Testes planeja, controla e aprimora continuamente as atividades de teste para garantir que o software e os sistemas integrados atendam aos padrões de qualidade definidos antes do lançamento. Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança.

Responsável por impulsionar práticas de teste consistentes e de alta qualidade em múltiplos projetos. A função garante um modelo de governança unificado, metodologias alinhadas e resultados de entrega previsíveis.



Principais Responsabilidades


• Definir, comunicar e garantir o cumprimento da estratégia geral de testes junto a todas as partes interessadas e equipes de entrega.

• Identificar, garantir e coordenar os recursos de teste alinhados ao escopo e aos marcos de entrega.

• Garantir que os ambientes de teste, os dados e as integrações de sistema estejam disponíveis e adequados à finalidade.

• Analisar e gerenciar defeitos, riscos e problemas decorrentes de todas as fases de teste.

Estabelecer e manter um repositório centralizado de cenários e ativos de teste.

• Identificar e reutilizar materiais de teste existentes para melhorar a eficiência e a consistência.

• Definir e finalizar o escopo de testes em conjunto com todas as áreas impactadas.

• Definir, preparar e validar os requisitos de dados de teste de acordo com o escopo acordado.

• Desenvolver planos detalhados de execução de testes diários, incluindo cenários de contingência e de menor prioridade.

• Definir e obter consenso sobre critérios claros de conclusão dos ciclos de teste.

• Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente.


Requisitos

Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.

• Ampla experiência prática em testes de software e garantia de qualidade em ambientes corporativos.

• Capacidade comprovada de liderar, coordenar e motivar equipes de teste em múltiplos fluxos de trabalho.

• Sólida experiência em planejamento, escopo, estimativa e análise de testes.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com stakeholders em equipes de negócios e técnicas.

• Mentalidade analítica com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.

• Experiência comprovada na definição, implementação e gestão de estratégias e planos de teste.

• Sólido conhecimento de modelos SDLC e uma ampla gama de metodologias de teste.

• Conhecimento prático de ferramentas, frameworks e melhores práticas de automação de testes.


Experiência Desejáveis

• Familiaridade com as plataformas SAP S/4HANA e Salesforce Lightning, incluindo módulos, aplicações e abordagens de entrega.

• Formação técnica com compreensão de integrações de sistemas e protocolos de interface.

• Experiência em planejamento e execução de testes de desempenho, carga e estresse.

• Forte experiência com modelos de entrega ágil e colaboração em equipes multifuncionais.

• Capacidade de análise de negócios, incluindo técnicas de levantamento e validação de requisitos.

• Experiência comprovada em TDD (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Testes).

• Experiência comprovada com Jira XRay, Selenium e Tricentis TTA

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.


Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Operations Director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director


Introduction:

Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.


This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.


Compensation:

  • $40,000-90,000 USD per year.


Duties & Responsibilities:


Permitting

  • Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
  • Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
  • Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
  • Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
  • Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
  • Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
  • Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
  • Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.


Development Support

  • Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
  • File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.


Procurement

  • Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
  • Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
  • Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.


Transaction Support

  • Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
  • Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
  • Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.


Qualifications:

  • University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
  • Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
  • Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
  • Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
  • Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
  • Willing to be responsive and communicative.
  • Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST.
  • The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
  • Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese)
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a trusted Oracle Partner, is a global IT solutions provider with offices in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. The company specialises in delivering smart, scalable, and future-ready IT solutions to empower businesses to evolve and lead. With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Offer Details:


Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home)

Contract Duration: 12 months

Number of Open Positions: 20


Key Qualifications

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process -

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description:
B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call)


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


Apply Here (See Instructions Below)


(


The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Analista de Operações de Crédito Imobiliário Sr
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Esqueça a burocracia dos bancões: a Volpi é a fintech que resolve. Simplificamos o financiamento imobiliário para deixar tudo 100% digital e infinitas vezes mais rápido. Trazemos décadas de experiência para transformar processos complexos em soluções ágeis, antecipando problemas e soluções. Tornamos a análise de crédito inteligente, feita sob medida para cada história. Com tecnologia proprietária construímos a solução completa, guiada por especialistas.

Você fará parte do time responsável pela formalização e emissão de contratos de crédito imobiliário , garantindo qualidade de informação, organização e agilidade em um contexto de alto volume de demandas e múltiplas interfaces (jurídico, comercial, clientes e parceiros externos).

Hoje, os principais desafios incluem:

  • Alto volume de contratos com necessidade de agilidade na emissão
  • Dependência de validações manuais
  • Necessidade de maior padronização e automação


O que esperamos de você:

  • Atuar na emissão e conferência de contratos com alto nível de atenção a detalhes
  • Garantir a aderência das minutas aos padrões internos e requisitos legais;
  • Controlar o fluxo de formalização das operações, acompanhando prazos e pendências;
  • Apoiar na validação documental e organização dos dossiês das operações;
  • Identificar inconsistências e riscos contratuais, sinalizando pontos de atenção;
  • Estruturar e manter controles operacionais (planilhas, trackers, relatórios)
  • Apoiar na geração de relatórios e acompanhamento de indicadores da área
  • Atuar de forma próxima com diferentes áreas internas, garantindo fluidez no processo
  • Identificar gargalos operacionais e propor melhorias práticas no dia a dia
  • Contribuir com iniciativas de automação e ganho de eficiência (incluindo uso de IA)


O que buscamos:

  • Formação superior (preferencialmente em Direito, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas);
  • 2 a 3 anos de experiência com análise e/ou elaboração de contratos;
  • Ser uma pessoa organizada, detalhista, com habilidade para lidar bem com volume, prazos e múltiplas demandas simultâneas
  • Perfil analítico , com facilidade para estruturar informações e processos
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento com diferentes áreas
  • Proatividade para identificar problemas e sugerir melhorias práticas


Como é trabalhar na Volpi:

Na Volpi, vivemos nossos princípios todos os dias:

  • Inconformismo & Protagonismo : Assumimos a responsabilidade em cada detalhe e buscamos incansavelmente evoluir em tudo que fazemos
  • Colaboração: Construímos juntos: todos são bem-vindos a levantar a mão e contribuir, expertise e informação são mais valiosos que cargos.
  • Eficiência radical : Executamos com foco e agilidade, usando tecnologia e expertise para reduzir riscos e eliminar gargalos.

Modelo remoto prioritário

title: Senior Biostatistician
description:
Senior Biostatistician (Remote)

Location: Colombia, Brazil, Chile, Philippines, Vietnam, China

Employment: Remote | Contract / Consultant

Compensation: USD $1–40/hour (based on experience)

Duration: Open-ended


Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Biostatistician Consultant to support clinical trial activities across global pharmaceutical and biotechnology projects. This role focuses on statistical leadership, study design, regulatory submissions, and collaboration with cross-functional clinical teams and CRO partners.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide statistical expertise and support for clinical trial design and execution
  • Contribute to study protocol development, including:
  • Study design discussions
  • Sample size calculations
  • Develop and review:
  • Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs)
  • Analysis datasets and TLG specifications
  • Review CRFs, edit checks, and data review guidelines
  • Perform statistical analyses and interpret results for clinical studies
  • Prepare clinical study reports (CSRs) and integrated summaries for regulatory submissions
  • Ensure compliance with FDA regulations, GCP, and CDISC standards
  • Support ADaM dataset specifications and QC activities
  • Review or author data transfer specifications from external vendors
  • Collaborate with CROs, vendors, and internal clinical teams to ensure deliverables meet timelines
  • Contribute to SOPs, work instructions, and statistical programming standards
  • Provide clear communication of statistical methodology to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or closely related quantitative field
  • PhD strongly preferred
  • Minimum 5+ years of clinical trial experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry (MANDATORY) Hospital, academic, or government experience does not qualify
  • Strong experience working with CROs strongly preferred
  • Solid knowledge of:
  • Clinical trial design and methodology
  • Sample size calculations
  • SAP development
  • CSR authoring and submission-ready outputs
  • Strong SAS programming skills (required)
  • Experience QCing efficacy/safety outputs
  • R programming is a plus
  • Strong understanding of CDISC standards (SDTM/ADaM)
  • Experience generating and QCing ADaM specifications and datasets
  • Oncology experience is a plus

Our team has completed over 300 projects and designed more than 3 million square feet of built space across sectors like hospitality, retail, franchises, healthcare and more.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is looking for a Senior Bookkeeper to take full ownership of our day-to-day financial operations. As a fast-growing firm with multiple simultaneous projects and an extensive client base, we need a senior professional who brings organization, predictability and continuous process improvement to our financial routine.


This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role. We're looking for someone highly process-oriented and analytically sharp, someone who sees beyond the numbers and proactively identifies gaps, anticipates problems and builds scalable financial systems. 


You'll work directly with leadership, turning financial data into clear insights that support strategic decisions.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation: R$8.000 - R$10.000
  • Schedule aligned with New York time zone (EST)


What you’ll do


1.Financial operations & accounts receivable

  • Manage the company's full financial routine end-to-end
  • Lead Accounts Receivable control, including invoice issuance, tracking and collections
  • Actively manage aging reports and conduct structured follow-ups with clients
  • Oversee correct categorization of all expenses
  • Conduct phone-based collections with U.S. clients, maintaining a professional and firm communication style


2.Reporting & financial intelligence

  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations with high accuracy
  • Prepare and analyze financial reports, including P&L, expense reports, cash flow and forecasts
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of all financial data
  • Deliver financial insights directly to leadership to support strategic decisions


3.Process improvement & systems

  • Develop, standardize and optimize internal financial processes
  • Implement billing systems and automated reminders
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and propose continuous improvements


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Solid experience (minimum 5 years) as a Bookkeeper or in a similar financial role
  • Proven experience managing full financial cycles (AR, expenses, reconciliations)
  • Proficiency in accounting software (Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero or similar)
  • 6+ years of experience with financial reporting (P&L, aging, cash flow)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken), this role includes direct phone collections with U.S.-based clients
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets
  • Strong analytical skills and extreme attention to detail
  • Ability to manage high transaction volumes and multiple clients simultaneously


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with financial system automations and integrations
  • Background in professional services firms (engineering, architecture, consulting, etc.)
  • Experience with U.S.-based financial operations
  • Track record of structuring or scaling financial processes


Who we're looking for

  • Senior profile with a true ownership mindset over the financial area
  • Extremely organized and process-driven
  • Proactive, with the ability to anticipate problems before they escalate
  • Professional communicator, especially when handling collections
  • Comfortable working independently and making decisions
  • Focused on efficiency, standardization and continuous improvement


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)

  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Katalon / Azure DevOps) - Brazil only
description:
Company Description

CalPac Consulting specializes in providing world-class IT talent and dedicated teams, enabling organizations to accelerate their product roadmaps and solve complex technical challenges. With a global presence and over a century of combined leadership experience, we deliver strategic global staffing that integrates seamlessly into your culture. Our \"Follow the Sun\" workflow ensures continuous project momentum, and we pride ourselves on agility, delivering candidate profiles within 24-48 hours. Our expertise spans the full Microsoft stack, full-stack development, QA (manual and automation), DevOps, and cutting-edge AI solutions.


Role Overview

Our client is seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer  to lead the transition from manual regression testing to fully automated execution in CI/CD. This is a hands-on role with clear ownership: build, stabilize, and run automated regression suites using Katalon Studio , fully integrated into Azure DevOps pipelines .

You’ll work across two enterprise web applications built with Angular (front end)  and C#/.NET (back end) , hosted in AWS and Azure . The expectation is not just writing tests, but owning execution reliability, test data strategy, and automation standards while mentoring a manual QA team.



Key Responsibilities

Katalon Automation & CI/CD

  • Build, refactor, and maintain automated regression suites in Katalon Studio
  • Execute Katalon tests in CI/CD pipelines  using Azure DevOps
  • Configure pipeline stages, triggers, and pass/fail quality gates
  • Troubleshoot CI-only failures (environment variables, drivers, headless execution)

Test Design & Stability

  • Convert recorded tests into maintainable, production-ready automation
  • Reduce test flakiness through robust selectors, waits, retries, and refactoring
  • Design reusable components, custom keywords, and data-driven tests

Test Data & Environments

  • Establish repeatable staging test data strategies  (seeding, teardown, isolation)
  • Address data collisions in shared environments
  • Coordinate API/UI automation for setup and validation

Mentorship & Standards

  • Upskill manual QA engineers transitioning into automation
  • Define automation standards, structure, and documentation
  • Conduct code reviews and guide best practices

Reporting & Metrics

  • Publish test results and trends in Azure DevOps
  • Track automation KPIs (coverage, pass rate, flakiness)
  • Communicate automation progress and risks to leadership



Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of QA Automation Engineering  experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Katalon Studio
  • Proven experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines  (Azure DevOps strongly preferred)
  • Experience automating Angular web applications
  • Solid understanding of REST API testing
  • Experience designing test data strategies  for non-prod environments
  • Comfortable writing maintainable automation code (Groovy/Java concepts)



Preferred Experience

  • Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and dashboards
  • AWS and Azure-hosted applications
  • C#/.NET application familiarity
  • Parallelized test execution
  • Experience mentoring or leading QA automation efforts
  • LIMS or other regulated enterprise systems (nice to have)



What Success Looks Like

  • Automated regression suites running reliably on every deployment
  • Reduced manual regression effort and release risk
  • Stable, maintainable Katalon test library the team can extend
  • Clear visibility into automation health and coverage

This role is the antidote to \"scope creep\" and undocumented meetings. We need a driver who can step into ambiguous strategic discussions, extract the concrete deliverables, define the scope, and relentlessly manage the execution. While you will not be managing client deployments or writing software code, you will act as the crucial link between our operational leaders and our internal systems/support teams. You will ensure that before we implement a new workflow or build a new internal tool, the business requirements are meticulously documented and agreed upon.

Key Responsibilities

Scope Capture & Definition

  • Own the Meeting Outcome: Attend internal strategy and planning meetings to act as the definitive owner of project scope. Ensure no meeting ends without documented consensus on exactly what is being executed, who owns it, and the timeline.
  • Translate Strategy to Action: Take high-level concepts from operations and HR leaders and distill them into strict, clear, and executable project plans.
  • Prevent Scope Creep: Act as the gatekeeper for internal initiatives, ensuring that any additions to a project's scope are properly vetted, documented, and given updated timelines.

Operations & Systems Liaison

  • Define Business Requirements: Partner with Operations to map out current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and document clear business requirements for new tools or processes.
  • Guide Systems Implementation: Manage the rollout of both off-the-shelf operational solutions and custom-built internal tools.
  • Support Internal Builders: Ensure that our internal development/systems support teams are only handed fully scoped, approved, and documented business requirements, preventing ad-hoc interruptions and misaligned builds.

Internal Project Leadership & Execution

  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Manage complex internal initiatives—such as operational restructuring, HR program launches, or new system integrations—from inception to completion.
  • Hold Stakeholders Accountable: Competently and confidently follow up with internal stakeholders at all levels (including Directors and VPs) to ensure tasks and dependencies are completed on time.
  • Maintain the Source of Truth: Build and maintain comprehensive project boards and dashboards (using Jira, Notion, etc.) so leadership has real-time visibility into internal project health.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Assertive Stakeholder Management: You are not afraid to hold department heads accountable to their deadlines. You can lead laterally without formal reporting authority.
  • Exceptional Scope Discipline: A proven track record of taking ambiguous business conversations and locking them down into clear, documented project scopes.
  • Business Process Mapping: You naturally see how to organize chaos into a step-by-step workflow and can clearly articulate how an operation should function.
  • Tool Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in project management and documentation tools like Jira, Notion, Asana, or Monday.com
  • Communication: Direct, clear, and highly organized written and verbal communication.
  • Experience leveraging automation or AI tools to improve workflows is preferred

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–6 years of project management experience, with a heavy emphasis on internal operations, process improvement, or business systems implementation.
  • Cross-Departmental Exposure: Proven experience running projects that span multiple internal departments (e.g., HR, IT, Operations).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Internal Delivery Rate: Percentage of internal operational projects delivered within planned timelines.
  • Scope Fidelity: Accuracy of initial project documentation and the minimization of undocumented post-kickoff changes.
  • Process Adoption: Successful rollout and sustained adoption of new internal workflows and operational systems.


Salary: $1,500-2,000 monthly USD

Our team works closely with businesses to deliver tailored solutions, dispatching professional technicians to support their operations.

Additionally, the agent will identify any complaints, concerns, or unresolved issues reported by customers and escalate them appropriately for further action. Clear communication, attention to detail, and the ability to capture accurate information are essential, as this role plays a key part in maintaining service quality and customer satisfaction.

This role is designed as an entry point into the company. Based on performance, candidates may be considered for advancement into a Customer Service Agent position or other departments.

title: Arquiteto De Soluções Sênior
description:
Viva a experiência SONDA

Aqui você transforma sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da SONDA?

Porque assim como você , amamos o que fazemos, temos paixão por inovação e estamos convencidos de que através do conhecimento e da tecnologia vamos transformar não só os negócios de nossos clientes, mas também o futuro.

  • Ser responsável por definir, desenhar e governar soluções de tecnologia da informação que atendam às necessidades do negócio, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade técnica, segurança, escalabilidade e viabilidade econômica das soluções propostas.

  • Levantar, analisar e compreender requisitos de negócio, técnicos e regulatórios.
  • Definir a arquitetura de soluções (aplicações, integrações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança).
  • Avaliar e selecionar tecnologias, frameworks, plataformas e padrões arquiteturais.
  • Garantir aderência às arquiteturas corporativas, padrões, políticas de segurança e boas práticas.
  • Elaborar diagramas arquiteturais, documentos técnicos e especificações de solução.
  • Atuar junto aos times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura, segurança e operações durante todo o ciclo de vida da solução.
  • Apoiar estimativas de esforço, custos, riscos e cronogramas.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos de mudanças e evoluções de sistemas.
  • Garantir escalabilidade, desempenho, resiliência, disponibilidade e segurança das soluções.
  • Orientar e apoiar tecnicamente desenvolvedores e arquitetos juniores.
  • Contribuir para a evolução da arquitetura corporativa e roadmap tecnológico.

Ideal se você tiver:

  • Formação de ensino superior completo;
  • Domínio profundo de princípios SOLID, Dry e padrões de design.
  • Experiência em arquitetura baseada em camadas e separação de responsabilidades.
  • Experiência prática em ambiente Azure (incluindo serviços de computação, storage e redes) integrada à estratégia multi-cloud (AWS/GCP).
  • Experiência com esteiras de CI/CD para automação de deploy.
  • Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos, REST/SOAP e ferramentas de Gateway de API.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem lógica e física de dados para suportar as soluções desenhadas.
  • Capacidade fundamental para realizar a ponte entre a diretoria técnica, gestores de negócio e os fornecedores.
  • Habilidade para explicar decisões técnicas complexas e orientar o time na implementação dos padrões definidos.
  • Atuação com Tecnologias Chave (Stack): Cloud: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud | Identity: Entra ID, AD | Integrations: OIC, API Manager | Patterns: SOLID, MVC, MVVM, Microservices | Documentation: Draw.Io, SharePoint.

O que você pode esperar de nós?

  • Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.
  • Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

O que oferecemos?

  • SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.
  • SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.
  • E muito mais!

+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração

Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

Faça parte da nossa equipe!

title: Coordenador De Corpops (Financeiro, Estratégia E Governança)
description:
Sobre a invoiSys

Estamos em um momento de aceleração. Como uma startup scale-up, nossa missão é escalar com inteligência. Para isso, buscamos não apenas um "executor", mas um parceiro estratégico para liderar nossa área de Corporate Operations (CorpOps).

O Desafio

Você será o braço direito da diretoria, sendo responsável por "arrumar a casa" e preparar o terreno para novos rounds de investimento. Este é um cargo híbrido ( hands-on + estratégico): você executará o financeiro atual enquanto constrói os processos de governança e análise que investidores e conselheiros exigem.

Suas Responsabilidades:

1. Gestão Financeira & Controladoria (Core):

  • Execução Direta: Gestão do contas a pagar/receber, conciliação bancária diária, faturamento e emissão de boletos.
  • Análise de Dados: Elaboração de DRE, Balanço Patrimonial e Fluxo de Caixa (Direto e Projetado).
  • KPIs de Tech: Monitoramento de métricas como Burn Rate, Runway, CAC e LTV.
  • Interface Contábil: Garantir que a contabilidade externa receba informações impecáveis para fechamentos rápidos e precisos.

2. Governança e Jurídico (Ops):

  • Gestão de Contratos: Intermediação jurídica, analisando contratos de clientes e fornecedores junto à nossa assessoria externa.
  • Compliance: Garantir que as melhores práticas de governança sejam seguidas, visando auditorias futuras e Due Diligence.
  • Relações com Investidores (RI): Preparação de relatórios e apresentações de alta qualidade para o conselho e potenciais investidores.

3. Liderança e Administrativo:

  • Gestão de Processos: Mapear e otimizar as rotinas do escritório e processos internos de Itapira.
  • Formação de Time: Ter habilidade para contratar, treinar e gerir estagiários ou assistentes conforme a área crescer sob sua liderança.

O que buscamos (Requisitos):

  • Formação em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou Engenharia.
  • Experiência sólida em Finanças/Controladoria (ideal se tiver passagem por startups ou empresas auditadas).
  • Mindset de Construção: Alguém que prefere criar processos do que apenas seguir os já existentes.
  • Excel avançado (você vai "conversar" com os números).
  • Residir em Itapira ou região, com disponibilidade para encontros presenciais estratégicos.

Diferenciais que valorizamos:

  • Experiência em empresas de Tecnologia/SaaS.
  • Vivência com estruturação de processos para captação de investimento.
  • Inglês (para leitura de termos de investimento/equity).

O que oferecemos:

  • A oportunidade de ser o "número 1" do financeiro em uma empresa em crescimento.
  • Autonomia real para sugerir mudanças e implementar sua visão de CorpOps.
  • Ambiente meritocrático e focado em resultados.

Modelo de contratação: PJ + benefícios

title: Fx trader
description:
Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.
Key Responsibilities
FX Trading & Liquidity Management
Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.
Hedging Strategy & Risk Management
Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
Monitor risk limits, Pn L, and exposure across currency books.
Trading Infrastructure & Systems
Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:
Automated hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation systems
Smart order routing
Pricing and risk management tools
Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.
Market Development
Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.
Requirements
Experience
5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as:
Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
Experience working at:
Global banks
EM FX trading firms
Payment / fintech companies
Crypto exchanges or market makers
Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.
Technical Expertise
Deep understanding of:
FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
NDF markets and offshore hedging
Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
FX trading systems
Hedging engines
Liquidity aggregation platforms
Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.
Skills
Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations.
Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources.
Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies.
Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations.
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments
Vision & Mission
OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a Pay Fi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2 B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and Stable X, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Apoiar documentação e organização da área;
