Nossa empresa A Control i D é uma indústria brasileira, especializada no desenvolvimento de relógio de ponto, controle de acesso e equipamentos para automação comercial.
Responsabilidades
Identificar e mapear novas oportunidades de mercado, especialmente nos segmentos de controle de acesso físico (portarias, estacionamentos, prédios corporativos, indústrias, etc.).
Estabelecer e desenvolver parcerias estratégicas com distribuidores, integradores e revendas.
Participar de eventos, feiras e encontros para ampliação de networking e geração de leads qualificados.
Estreitar o relacionamento com os canais parceiros, promovendo a fidelização e o engajamento.
Requisitos
Excelente comunicação e habilidade de negociação.
Conhecimento em soluções de controle de acesso.
Disponibilidade para locomoção para as cidades do interior de São Paulo, principalmente na região de Campinas.
Carro próprio - viagens de avião são pagas pela empresa.
Benefícios
VR/VA sem desconto em folha;
Custeio de gasolina/despesas com clientes pela empresa;
Convênio médico com coparticipação apenas quando usar (válido apenas para o titular);
PLR baseado no salário da categoria do sindicato;
Seguro de Vida em grupo;
Totalpass;
OBS - a posição não conta com comissionamentos por venda.

title: Supervisor de recrutamento e seleção
description:
Sua nova empresa
Faça parte de uma grande líder global em soluções logísticas, reconhecida por sua robustez operacional, cultura de melhoria contínua e forte foco em segurança, eficiência e excelência na jornada do cliente. A companhia possui atuação nacional e internacional, sendo referência em inovação e qualidade na gestão de transportes, operações complexas e serviços logísticos integrados.
Sua nova posição
Como Supervisor(a) de Recrutamento & Seleção de alto volume , você será peça-chave na consolidação da nova estrutura centralizada de Talent Acquisition, atuando diretamente no desenho, gestão e operação do processo de R&S de alto volume em âmbito nacional.
Reportando-se à alta liderança da área, você apoiará todas as regiões na condução de processos seletivos críticos e será responsável por liderar coordenadoras regionais, garantindo fluidez operacional, alinhamento estratégico e alta performance da equipe.
Além de atuar estrategicamente, esta posição exige forte capacidade de execução e presença ativa na rotina – sendo fundamental colocar a mão na massa sempre que necessário.
A área está em pleno processo de transição: atualmente são cerca de 85 profissionais de R&S, e você assumirá a liderança direta e indireta de aproximadamente 30 pessoas, com grande potencial de crescimento futuro para uma posição gerencial.
Principais responsabilidades
Conduzir e liderar a operação de Recrutamento & Seleção de alto volume.
Garantir o cumprimento e evolução dos principais indicadores de performance:
Volume de vagas
Tempo médio de fechamento
Qualidade da base e aderência de perfis
Indicadores de diversidade
Taxa de desistência
Controle e gestão do faturamento das consultorias de R&S
Atuação próxima aos clientes internos, com postura madura, clara e orientada à solução.
Gestão e desenvolvimento das coordenadoras regionais de R&S.
Negociação e relacionamento com fornecedores, incluindo prazos, processos e faturamento.
Apoio estratégico na transição do modelo descentralizado para a célula corporativa.
O que precisa para ser bem-sucedido
Buscamos uma profissional com sólida experiência em recrutamento de alto volume , forte capacidade de gestão de times e vivência em ambientes de grande escala.
Requisitos essenciais:
Experiência robusta em operações de R&S com grande volume de vagas.
Vivência em empresas ou consultorias com demanda massiva (alto volume efetivo e temporário).
Experiencia fazendo gestão de fornecedores (Consultorias)
Gestão de equipes grandes e distribuídas.
Inglês necessário.
Conhecimento em ferramentas de recrutamento (Linked In, Info Jobs, Catho).
Experiência com múltiplas áreas funcionais e operações de larga escala.
O que você obterá em troca
A oportunidade de liderar uma operação estratégica de R&S em plena transformação, com alta exposição às principais lideranças da companhia e impacto direto na construção do novo modelo de Talent Acquisition.
Você atuará em um ambiente colaborativo, dinâmico, com grande espaço para melhorias e desenvolvimento profissional, além de potencial real de evolução para uma futura posição gerencial.
O que precisa fazer agora
Se estiver interessada nesta posição, clique em “Aplicar-se agora” para enviar seu CV atualizado ou entre em contato conosco para mais informações.

title: Gerente contábil
description:
Responsabilidades
- Gerir todas as rotinas contábeis da área, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e a qualidade das entregas;
- Supervisionar e validar os fechamentos contábeis mensais e anuais, assegurando a integridade das informações e aderência às normas vigentes (CPC/IFRS);
- Revisar e aprovar demonstrações contábeis (BP, DRE, DFC, DMPL, Notas Explicativas), obrigações acessórias (ECD, ECF, DCTFWeb, entre outras) e apurações fiscais;
- Acompanhar e apoiar atendimentos a auditorias externas e fiscalizações, garantindo organização, transparência e segurança da informação;
- Gerenciar o relacionamento com clientes estratégicos, prestando suporte técnico de alto nível e atuando como referência de confiança;
- Atuar na identificação de oportunidades comerciais, elaboração de propostas e venda de serviços contábeis para clientes atuais e potenciais;
- Representar a área contábil em reuniões comerciais e estratégicas, contribuindo para o crescimento da base de clientes e a ampliação dos serviços prestados;
- Liderar e desenvolver a equipe contábil (supervisores, analistas e assistentes), promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e focado em resultados;
- Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área, propondo melhorias contínuas em processos, sistemas e atendimento;
- Atuar junto à diretoria na definição de estratégias para o crescimento da área, retenção de clientes e padronização de rotinas;
- Garantir o alinhamento da equipe às políticas internas, atualizações legais e boas práticas contábeis, comerciais e de gestão.
Requisitos
Formação em Ciências Contábeis;
Possuir CRC Ativo;
Excel Avançado;
Conhecimento técnico e prático nas atividades Contábeis;
Conhecimento com Gestão de equipes;
Diferencial conhecer as ferramentas: Microsoft 365 (Teams/Share Point); Power Platform (Power BI/Apps/Automate); Azure (Data Factory/SQL/Storage); SQL Server; Python; DAX/M; REST/Graph APIs; Git/Azure Dev Ops; Jira/Confluence; DAX Studio/Profiler
Salário e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.

title: Personal trainer
description:
Descrição da Empresa O Raquel Facanali Treinamento Físico Personalizado foi estruturado para proporcionar atendimento exclusivo e individualizado. Desenvolvemos nosso trabalho com foco nos objetivos, características, perfil e necessidades dos nossos clientes. Em ambiente diferenciado e com fluxo controlado de pessoas, as sessões são agendadas previamente, de acordo a disponibilidade do aluno.
O estúdio reúne serviços relacionados à conceitos de bem-estar, qualidade de vida, saúde e estética.
Temos nossa própria metodologia validada e contamos com uma equipe multidisciplinar composta por personais, fisioterapeutas e nutricionista altamente atualizados e capacitados.
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um(a) Professor(a) de Educação Física para integrar a equipe do Estúdio Raquel Facanali em Campinas, SP. O cargo exige o planejamento e a condução de aulas de educação física e atividades físicas, além do desenvolvimento de planos de aula que se adaptem às necessidades dos alunos. O(a) profissional também será responsável por orientar os estudantes na execução dos exercícios e promover práticas saudáveis de forma dinâmica e motivadora. Este é um cargo com contrato e demanda a presença no local.
Qualificações Educação Física e Ensino: Necessário ter formação em educação física, CREF ativo, com experiência em desenvolver e lecionar conteúdos didáticos relacionados à área. Treinamento Esportivo: Experiência em coaching esportivo e na aplicação de técnicas eficazes para o progresso físico dos alunos é essencial. Planejamento Curricular: Competência em desenvolver planos de aula e currículos adaptados às necessidades e habilidades de diferentes perfis de alunos. Será considerado um diferencial ter experiência com grupos diversificados, boas habilidades de comunicação e certificações específicas na área de educação física.

title: Analista de recursos humanos sênior
description:
A Hunter Douglas, multinacional centenária e líder em cortinas, persianas e soluções arquitetônicas, agora parte do portfólio da 3 G Capital, está em busca de novos talentos que queiram fazer parte de uma jornada de inovação e crescimento.
Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar como Analista de Gente e Gestão Sênior , com olhar atento e domínio em folha de pagamento. Essa posição é essencial para garantir precisão, conformidade e fluidez nas rotinas operacionais, além de apoiar o time e as lideranças com segurança e proximidade. Se você tem perfil analítico, organizado e gosta de estruturar processos com responsabilidade, essa oportunidade é pra você.
Oportunidade: Analista de RH Sênior (perfil generalista)
Nível de ensino: Superior completo em Administração, Psicologia, Contabilidade, Gestão de RH e/ou áreas correlatas.
Responsabilidades:
Atuação estratégica e operacional, com foco em folha e rotinas de departamento pessoal.
Conhecimento aprofundado das rotinas da folha de pagamento (cálculos, encargos, conferências e prazos).
Garantia de conformidade com legislação trabalhista e previdenciária.
Acompanhamento de processos admissionais, benefícios, rescisões e ponto eletrônico.
Suporte a lideranças em temas de People, políticas e rotinas de RH.
Análise e melhoria de processos, com olhar para eficiência e riscos.
Perfil analítico, organizado e com alta atenção a detalhes.
Autonomia, e forte senso de responsabilidade.
Requisitos obrigatórios:
Experiência sólida com folha de pagamento e rotinas de Departamento Pessoal.
Domínio da legislação trabalhista e previdenciária.
Vivência com encargos (INSS, FGTS, IRRF, e Social).
Experiência com processos de R&S, admissão, rescisão e controle de ponto.
Conhecimento em sistemas TOTVS (Protheus).
Excel avançado (controle, conferência e análise de dados).
Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% presencial em Campinas/SP.
Diferenciais:
Experiência em companhias multinacionais.
Inglês e/ou espanhol.

title: Assistente de backoffice
description:
Resumo da Posição: O Backoffice Jr será responsável pelo processamento e acompanhamento dos pedidos gerados pela equipe de vendas. Atuando de forma ágil e precisa, o profissional garantirá a correta gestão dos pedidos, contribuindo para a eficiência do fluxo comercial e a satisfação dos clientes.
Principais Responsabilidades:
·       Gestão de Pedidos: Cadastrar e processar os pedidos originados pela equipe de vendas com precisão e agilidade.
Monitorar o andamento dos pedidos, assegurando a execução conforme os prazos estabelecidos.
Identificar e solucionar eventuais pendências ou inconsistências nos pedidos.
·       Suporte Operacional: Realizar follow-up junto aos setores internos para garantir a integração e a eficiência do processo de atendimento.
Manter comunicação constante com a equipe de vendas para esclarecimento de dúvidas e alinhamento das informações dos pedidos.
·       Controle e Registro de Informações: Atualizar sistemas de gestão (ERP ou CRM) com dados precisos e atualizados dos pedidos.
Qualificações Ensino médio completo; Boa capacidade de comunicação e escrita; Excel básico; Vivência com gestão de CRM e ERP; Experiência em atendimento ao cliente.
Proposta:
Salário: Fixo R$ 2.500,00
• Benefícios: Vale refeição, convênio odontológico e vale transporte.
• Regime de contratação: CLT (Efetivo)
• Horário: Segunda a Sexta, das 8h às 18h com intervalo de 1 hora de almoço.

title: Estagiário de people analytics
description:
A Hunter Douglas, multinacional centenária e líder em cortinas, persianas e soluções arquitetônicas, agora parte do portfólio da 3 G Capital, está em busca de jovens talentos que queiram fazer parte de uma jornada de inovação e crescimento!
Combinando o legado de uma marca renomada com o modelo de gestão mais eficiente do mercado, nosso Programa de Estágio oferece a oportunidade de aprender, se desenvolver e crescer junto com uma empresa que tem o propósito de ser a mais amada, a que mais cresce e a mais eficiente.
Buscamos alguém curioso, analítico e organizado para atuar na interface entre pessoas & dados . Esse(a) estagiário(a) será responsável por apoiar na construção e no acompanhamento de indicadores de RH e em análises que apoiem decisões do negócio. Além disso, auxiliará também nas rotinas gerais de People, prestando atendimento aos colaboradores e participando ativamente de reuniões e ações da área. Se você gosta de números, organização e quer desenvolver um olhar estratégico dentro de RH, essa oportunidade é para você!
Oportunidade: Estágio em People Analytics
Nível de ensino: Cursando ensino superior em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Psicologia, Estatística, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
Atribuições:
Apoiar na coleta, organização e atualização de bases de dados de RH.
Auxiliar na construção e acompanhamento de indicadores (headcount, turnover, absenteísmo, entre outros).
Apoiar na criação e atualização de dashboards e relatórios gerenciais.
Realizar análises básicas de dados para geração de insights.
Dar suporte na gestão e controle de benefícios (movimentações, conferências e bases)
Garantir a qualidade e consistência das informações de People.
Apoiar na melhoria de processos e rotinas da área com foco em dados.
Interagir com diferentes áreas para levantamento e validação de informações.
Auxiliar em rotinas gerais, como desenvolvimento de ações, pesquisa, atendimento e demais iniciativas da área.
Requisitos obrigatórios:
Estar cursando ensino superior.
Disponibilidade para escala 100% presencial (6h diárias, de segunda à sexta-feira).
Conhecimento intermediário de Excel (mínimo).
Experiência prévia com banco e análise de dados/indicadores.
Diferenciais:
Inglês e/ou espanhol.
Familiaridade com Power BI.
Conhecimento de Protheus e Oracle.
Experiência prévia em companhias multinacionais.

title: Video ad expert
description:

We're looking for a Video Ad Creative Expert who knows how to turn ideas into high-performing short-form ads across Tik Tok and Meta (Facebook/Instagram).
This is not a generic editing role. We need someone who understands attention, pacing, hooks, and conversion-driven creative and can execute at a high level using modern tools, motion design, and AI-generated talent (avatars/voice).
Submission of video ads design portfolio REQUIRED to be considered for the position. We expect to see real animation effects (not stock videos with text layovers).

title: Senior electrical bim engineer
description:
Eracore is an electrical engineering and BIM company delivering complex Electrical BIM models for large construction projects across the U. S. Our team brings together top talent to work on some of the most interesting and technically demanding electrical projects, including data centers, government facilities, industrial buildings, and advanced commercial projects.
We are proud of the work we do, and we invite you to take a look:
Eracore is growing in Brazil, and we are excited to welcome new team members. We are building a permanent and professional team to work on Electrical BIM projects for the U. S. market. If you enjoy teamwork, learning, and doing quality work, you will feel at home with us.
Why You'll Enjoy Working at Eracore
Competitive hourly pay
Continuing Education
Sports & Fitness
Fully remote work
Healthy work–life balance
Learning platforms for professional growth
Supportive leadership and mentorship Your Role
Perform hands-on VDC and Electrical BIM production, including modeling, coordination, shop drawings, and prefabrication deliverables.
Ensure all work complies with design intent, NEC codes, and client requirements.
Take full ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables with minimal supervision.
Identify and resolve clashes and coordination issues and support the development of coordination-ready drawings.
Manage tasks, project schedules, and internal deadlines effectively.
Participate in client coordination meetings to align design intent, standards, and technical requirements.
Support RFIs and technical clarifications as required.
Provide technical guidance, coaching, and oversight to junior and mid-level engineers.
Maintain strong proficiency in Revit, Navisworks, Evolve, and other required VDC tools. What We're Looking For

title: Finance analyst - collection, finance
description:
About Voxy
Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.
Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.
We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you're on board, we would be happy to discuss.
You can find additional information about our values at this link (
The Impact You'll Have at Voxy
Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.
What You'll Be Doing:
Collections & Cash Application:
• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.
• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.
• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.
• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP& A Manager.
• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.
• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.
• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.
Credit Analysis & Risk Management:
• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.
• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.
• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.
Reporting & Analysis:
• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.
• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.
• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.
• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP& A Manager or Senior FP& A Analyst.
What We're Looking For:
• B. A/B. S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;
• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;
• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;
• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;
• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;
• Based anywhere in Brazil
• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish
• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.
Job Details:
• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year
• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)
In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you'll enjoy:
• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)
• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events
• Remote friendly work policies
• Professional development budget
• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify
• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world
• Time Zones: ET(Eastern Time), BRT(Brasilia Time), SAMT(Samara Standard Time), Central European Time (CET)
We believe in a workplace that is meant for everyone. Voxy is an equal opportunity employer.
Voxy believes that a creative, engaged and diverse team can transform the market and positively impact people's lives through education. We are sure that the mission of building the most effective way to learn English is done with a plurality of ideas and points of view, which is why we work to promote Diversity, Equity and Inclusion initiatives in our company.
In addition to training, benchmarking, and community partnerships, we also work in alignment with our internal DEI Committee.
As a reflection of our beliefs around inclusion in the workplace, our selection process has no restrictions; our goal is to assemble a diverse team that will help us be leaders in our market.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Learn more about our DEI initiatives and ERGs by clicking here.

title: Salesforce crm specialist
description:
Position Overview:
As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate.
This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content.
Key Responsibilities:
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):
Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact.
Client Journey:
Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups.
Data Segmentation and Hygiene:
Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database.
Testing & Quality Control:
Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance.
Performance & Reporting:
Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights.
Operational Support:
Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.
Platform Integrations:
Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud
Ability to work on-site at the company's headquarters at least 4 days per week
Preferred Qualifications:
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification
Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM
Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries
Familiarity with booking or practice management systems
Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement
Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures
Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

title: Accounting manager
description:
This role is for the person who:
Wants to help founders of e Commerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged. The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.
To support our continued growth, this is an active position we're currently recruiting for.
About Up Counting
We're a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping e Commerce and digital-first businesses scale with confidence.
Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.
We use smart systems and automation to deliver high-quality, efficient work across every department.
We prioritize a respectful, collaborative environment where people feel supported and have space for life outside of work.
We trust our team to lead with ownership and care — autonomy is part of our DNA.
What You'll Be Doing
Team Leadership: Manage and mentor a team of Accountants to deliver accurate, timely, high-quality work.
Full-Cycle Accounting Oversight: Review reconciliations, financial reports, and month-end close deliverables across multiple client files.
Operational Excellence: Ensure Up Counting's accounting processes are followed consistently and improve them where needed.
Client Support & Communication: Help clients understand their numbers, communicate insights clearly, and ensure smooth financial operations.
System & Process Optimization: Identify automation opportunities and contribute to scalable, efficient workflows alongside Controllers and senior leadership.
What You Bring
5+ years of experience in accounting management, ideally within a firm or multi-client environment.
High proficiency in Quick Books Online and/or Xero (Net Suite is a bonus).
Excellent communication and leadership skills — you elevate the people around you.
Strong technical foundation across full-cycle accounting, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
Comfortable using automation tools and improving processes.
FP& A or financial modeling experience is an asset.
A calm, structured leadership style — you bring clarity without micromanagement.
Perks & Culture
Because great work deserves a great place to do it.
Fully Remote + Async
Work flexibly from anywhere. During your first six months, you'll align closely with EST hours (9am–5pm) to onboard smoothly, then transition to 70% overlap.
Work from Anywhere
We care about outcomes, not location.
Paid Time Off
Enjoy paid time off, Me Days, Stat Holidays in your region, and our year-end company office closure.
Grow With Us
We promote from within based on performance, leadership, reliability, and impact.
Continuous Learning
We invest in your development through certifications, internal training, and ongoing learning.
Fair and Market-Aligned Compensation
Competitive pay matched to your experience and local market.
Your Journey at Up Counting
Your First Week
Meet the People Team and Accounting leadership, onboard into our systems, connect with your direct reports, and understand our workflows across tools, teams, and time zones.
Month 1
You'll be managing client files, team rhythms, and weekly deliverables. You'll be leading your team through core processes, learning the review system end-to-end, and begin shaping how we operate.
In 3 Months
You'll fully own your portfolio of accountants and clients—setting priorities, supporting performance, ensuring high-quality delivery, and improving workflows. You'll be a go-to leader with autonomy and clarity.
Curious About Our Values & Culture?
They're built around excellence, autonomy, respect, and curiosity. Learn more on our Careers Page.
How We Hire
Our process is transparent, straightforward, and human:
Apply via Typeform: Short questions + a brief video.
Introductory Call: A short conversation with our People Team to align expectations.
Scenario-Based Assessment + Technical Review: A strategic exercise reviewed by our senior finance team.
Final Interview: A culture and alignment conversation with leadership.
Offer: If it's a mutual fit, we move quickly — great partnerships shouldn't wait.
No cover letter needed, just tell us what drew you to Up Counting. Every application is reviewed by our People team — we don't use AI to screen or assess candidates. Thoughtful hiring matters to us.

title: Cloud operations engineer
description:
About Eightpoint
Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U. S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.
About the Role
The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the Dev Ops team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the Dev Ops and Systems Administration teams.
Key Responsibilities

Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, Cloud Front, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
Support GCP workloads, primarily Big Query pipelines and related data infrastructure.
Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; Cloud Watch; One Uptime).
Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.
Who You Are

5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, Dev Ops, or infrastructure support role.
Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, Cloud Front).
Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Git Hub Actions.
Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with GCP, specifically Big Query and related data services.
Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, Sys Ops, or Dev Ops Engineer).
Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Engenheiro de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a Volpi
Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!
O desafio
Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.
Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.
Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.
O que você vai fazer: Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS; Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ; Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio; Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados; Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.
O que esperamos de você: Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev); Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção; Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM; Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C) ; Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia; Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero; Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.
Será considerado um diferencial:
Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Desenvolvedor de .net senior, brasil
description:
We are tech transformation specialists, uniting human expertise with AI to create scalable tech solutions.
With over 8,000 CI& Ters around the world, we’ve built partnerships with more than 1,000 clients during our 30 years of history. Artificial Intelligence is our reality.
We are looking for a Senior. NET Engineer to join our team and contribute to the development and integration of complex software solutions focused on back-end development. This role will require working closely with a multicultural team spread across Brazil, Colombia, the UK, and the USA, with all communication conducted in English.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain back-end services using C#, ADO. NET, and SQL Server.
Implement and evolve SOAP and REST APIs, ensuring best practices and versioning standards.
Ensure service reliability through unit and integration testing, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
Collaborate on integration between various systems and services, applying software design patterns.
Conduct code reviews and provide mentorship to junior team members.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends, applying them to improve existing solutions.
Contribute to CI/CD workflows and best practices to enhance development efficiency.
Required Skills and Qualifications:
Strong experience with. NET Framework and. NET Core in production systems.
Solid understanding of ADO. NET and SQL Server, with experience in database design and performance tuning. Hands-on experience with SOAP and RESTful services.
Proficiency in XML serialization/deserialization.
Experience with IA plattforms.
Strong understanding of software design patterns and best practices.
Effective communication skills and resilience in fast-paced, multicultural teams.
Advanced English proficiency.
Soft Skills:
Proactive ownership of tasks with a mindset for continuous improvement.
Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative team player who values shared success.
Ability to adapt to ambiguity and shifting requirements.
Nice-to-Have Skills:
Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
Familiarity with specification-driven development and agentic approaches to software development.
Exposure to Agile development methodologies.
If you are a seasoned back-end developer looking to take on complex challenges in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a part of our diverse team!

title: Operations director
description:
Kinetic Homes - Operations Director
Introduction:
Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years.
This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future.
Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year.
Duties & Responsibilities:
Permitting
Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects.
Complete and submit permit applications for new construction.
Assist with septic permits and HOA applications.
Address permit application rejections in a timely manner.
Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone.
Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables.
Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation.
Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction.
Development Support
Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team.
File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county.
Procurement
Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing.
Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction.
Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements.
Transaction Support
Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts.
Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions.
Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms.
Qualifications:
University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment
Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF.
Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively.
Possess strong verbal and written English skills.
Must be highly organized and attentive to detail.
Willing to work in high-pressure environment.
Willing to be responsive and communicative.
Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9 AM to 5 PM EST.
The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal.
Good attitude necessary.

title: Video ad expert
description:
Please only apply if you are really a short-form 'video ad' expert level designer.
We’re looking for a Video Ad Creative Expert who knows how to turn ideas into high-performing short-form ads across Tik Tok and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) .
This is not a generic editing role. We need someone who understands attention, pacing, hooks, and conversion-driven creative and can execute at a high level using modern tools, motion design, and AI-generated talent (avatars/voice) .
Submission of video ads design portfolio REQUIRED to be considered for the position. We expect to see real animation effects (not stock videos with text layovers).
See a real work sample spec here. If your portfolio is selected, then we will offer you to do a paid work test based on this exact spec.
About Us
Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.
 
What You'll Be Doing
• Create short-form video ads (5–30 seconds) optimized for:
-Tik Tok
-Instagram Reels
-Facebook Feed & Stories
• Develop scroll-stopping hooks within the first 1–3 seconds
• Use advanced motion design to increase retention:
-Kinetic typography
-Dynamic text overlays
-Pattern interrupts
-Seamless jump cuts
• Execute clean, high-impact transitions , including:
-Speed ramps
-Zoom cuts
-Match cuts
-Masking transitions
-Flash/whip transitions (used strategically, not overdone)
• Work with AI avatars & voice tools :
-Synthesia, Hey Gen, or similar
-Lip-sync alignment
-Natural pacing and tone
-Avatar scene composition + background styling
• Combine:
-Stock footage
-B-roll
-Screen recordings
-UI overlays
into cohesive, high-converting creatives
• Rapidly produce and iterate on multiple variations per concept
What We’re Looking For
• Proven experience creating direct-response video ads (not just content)
• Strong understanding of:
-Hook → Build → Payoff structure
-Watch time & retention mechanics
-Platform-native editing styles (Tik Tok-first)
• Advanced skills in:
-Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects / Cap Cut (or similar)
-Motion graphics & text animation
-Audio syncing, beat matching, and pacing
• Experience with AI video tools (REQUIRED):
AI avatars (Hey Gen, Synthesia, etc.)
AI voiceovers (Eleven Labs or similar)
Basic prompt structuring for consistency • Ability to create:
Fast-paced, engaging edits without looking chaotic Clean, modern, mobile-first design
Bonus (Highly Preferred)
Experience in performance marketing / paid ads
Understanding of Meta & Tik Tok ad compliance
Experience with financial, newsletter, or lead-gen offers Ability to interpret performance data and iterate based on results
Deliverables
Multiple ad variations per concept (hooks, angles, edits)
Formats:
9:16 (primary)
1:1 and 4:5 (Meta variants)
Clean file organization + editable project files
How You Think
You understand that creative = targeting
You test fast, iterate faster
You care about performance, not just aesthetics You know when to simplify vs. when to add intensity

title: English teacher with advanced portuguese skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:

Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.
Minimum Requirements:

Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.
Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Professor De Espanhol
description: Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Além disso, terá um papel ativo na gestão das entregas, acompanhando o andamento das atividades, identificando riscos e garantindo que os compromissos assumidos sejam cumpridos com qualidade. Também contribuirá com decisões de arquitetura e direcionamento técnico, apoiando o time na construção de soluções robustas, escaláveis e alinhadas às boas práticas. Por fim, será responsável por desenvolver o time, atuando com mentoria, feedbacks técnicos e nivelamento de conhecimento. Como será seu dia a dia? Alinhar objetivos do time e assegurar a execução dos processos internos;
Acompanhar dinâmicas de equipes ágeis, facilitando a comunicação e desbloqueando obstáculos;
Apoiar o time de projetos na criação de cronogramas e estimativas;
Realizar entrevistas técnica para novos membros e definir perfis necessários junto à coordenação;
Assegurar que as ferramentas de trabalho (JIRA, documentação) estejam atualizadas;

Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java, com atuação consistente em ambientes de produção e entendimento do ciclo completo de desenvolvimento (do desenho à sustentação);

Experiência com containers ( Docker e/ou Kubernetes ), entendendo o ciclo de vida das aplicações e sua execução em ambientes containerizados;
Experiência na construção e integração de APIs RESTful, seguindo boas práticas de design, versionamento e segurança;

Experiência com testes unitários, garantindo qualidade e confiabilidade do código entregue;
Vivência atuando comoreferência técnica ou liderança de times, apoiando decisões, direcionando soluções e contribuindo com a evolução técnica da equipe;
Capacidade analítica,autonomia, proatividade e segurança na tomada de decisão em cenários de pressão ou ambiguidade. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir experiência com práticas de DevOps e construção de pipelines de CI/CD;

Tiver conhecimento emferramentas de busca e monitoramento, como ElasticSearch. Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Market Data Infrastructure Engineer
description:
IMPORTANT: Eligible locations in LATAM: Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico. Company Description Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. We are committed to excellence, collaboration, and consistently exceeding performance expectations across a wide range of industries. Our Client Our client is one of the world's leading investment banks, founded in the 19th century, offers a broad range of services, including investment banking, securities trading, and asset management. Role Description We are looking for a skilled professional to join our Market Data Infrastructure team, focused on managing and resolving infrastructure issues and ensuring optimal performance of real-time data services. Key Responsibilities: Resolving Data quality issues, this includes root cause analysis while managing internal and external vendors to resolve Data issues. Support On-call, incident management, problem and change managements. Ensuring optimal accuracy and timeliness of Data on a real-time basis while implementing monitoring tools to detect data issues. Work closely with regional and global Market Data Infrastructure teams to share knowledge and experience to enrich the team's capability and work together to provide a high level quality of services on Market Data. L2 Alert Management. Management of alerts that require knowledge for resolutions, creating and/or updating resolutions into knowledge base, run books, scripts and ITRS rules where possible Incident Management. Managing of incident lifecycle from identification to resolution, ensuring mitigation of business impact in the production environment. Change Management. Management of the process of making production changes to the ticker plant like Mandatory updates which includes content, software changes/upgrades that are performed by vendors or internal teams where only checkouts are necessary. Others: Release Management, Event Management, User support, Reporting. What We're Looking For? - Minimum 3-5 years of experience - Experience with Market Data Thomson Reuters Enterprise Platform (TREP) or Refinitiv Real-Time Distribution System (RTDS) and DACS .
- Good understanding of Market Data platforms e.G. Refinitiv, Bloomberg, direct feed providers.
- Proficient with Linux/ Windows operating systems and network level tuning and editing scripts - preferred scripting language: Bash/Python. Experience with networking and connectivity skills e.G. multicast, routing, switches, TCP/IP. Good communication and oral and written English skills is a must Understanding of ITIL Foundation and IT Best practices Skills which are not mandatory but are advantage: Geneos ITRS EXEGY (formerly Wombat/Vela) Market Data API AWS ECS, AWS VPC, including VPC Endpoints What We Offer? A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented company Remote work, or Hybrid based on candidates’ preferences Continuous development and training opportunities A competitive salary package with additional social benefits Interesting and challenging tasks The opportunity to work in an international and multicultural environment Regular team events Long-term career prospects

description: A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para desenvolver uma força de trabalho diversificada que promova um ambiente onde as pessoas se sintam apoiadas em compartilhar abertamente sua criatividade e habilidades que lhes permitam ser o mais bem-sucedidas possível. Se você está interessado em trabalhar para a Phibro, mas sente que não atende todos os requisitos, recomendamos que você se candidate, pois pode ser o candidato certo para esta posição ou outros processos seletivos. Responsabilidades: Liderar o desempenho técnico e comercial da linha de produtos sob sua responsabilidade nos países da região South America Region (SAR), assegurando crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e posicionamento competitivo. Atuar de forma integrada entre as áreas técnica e de marketing, sendo responsável pelo planejamento, implementação e acompanhamento das estratégias regionais, garantindo a correta aplicação dos produtos e fortalecendo a credibilidade da marca nos mercados da região. Desenvolver e executar anualmente o Plano Estratégico de Marketing da linha, estabelecendo metas claras de volume, margem e posicionamento. Definir e comunicar a proposta de valor dos produtos, traduzindo diferenciais técnicos em argumentos comerciais consistentes e relevantes para o mercado. Gerenciar o portfólio regional, revisando o mix de produtos e identificando oportunidades de lançamentos, atualizações ou descontinuações com base no ciclo de vida, desempenho e potencial de mercado. Estabelecer e revisar estratégias de precificação, equilibrando competitividade e rentabilidade. Liderar o desenvolvimento de campanhas e materiais de marketing em parceria com equipes internas e agências, incluindo conteúdos técnicos e promocionais. Acompanhar o mercado e a concorrência, produzindo análises que subsidiem decisões estratégicas e oportunidades de crescimento. Participar do processo de S&OP, assegurando alinhamento entre planejamento de marketing, previsão de demanda e disponibilidade de produtos. Planejar e coordenar estudos de campo, testes e validações científicas, garantindo consistência técnica e conformidade regulatória. Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com consultores, universidades e formadores de opinião (KOLs), ampliando a credibilidade técnica da marca. Participar de visitas estratégicas e discussões técnicas com clientes-chave, contribuindo diretamente para decisões, relacionamento e posicionamento da marca. Priorizar atividades de alto impacto, evitando envolvimento em rotinas operacionais de campo. Conduzir treinamentos técnicos internos durante reuniões periódicas, promovendo a capacitação contínua da equipe de vendas. Promover o alinhamento técnico entre os países da região (SAR), compartilhando melhores práticas e padronizando o posicionamento dos produtos.
