title: Account Manager
description: Job Title: Business Development Representative Job level: Jr Analyst Department: LATAM Sales &Marketing Reports To: Service & Warranty Manager for LATAM Location: Indaiatuba City, São Paulo, Brazil SVP Worldwide is the world’s largest consumer sewing machine company, proudly home to the iconic brands SINGER®, HUSQVARNA® VIKING®, PFAFF®, and CREATIVATE™. Together, our brands represent nearly 500 years of combined leadership, empowering sewists around the world and shaping the evolution of sewing for generations. Our purpose is clear: to create, elevate, and celebrate sewists around the world. With global operations spanning R&D, manufacturing, distribution, and sales, SVP Worldwide brings together heritage craftsmanship and modern innovation to serve a worldwide community of makers. Our expanding portfolio includes sewing and embroidery machines, accessories and notions, garment care, and creative software — offering meaningful opportunities to innovate, collaborate, and make an impact. Guided by our values — customer-first thinking, curiosity and creativity, inclusion, and transparency — we’re building a connected, inclusive culture where people can grow their careers while helping define the future of sewing. Position Summary We are looking for a professional to manage nationwide sales of maintenance parts for domestic and industrial sewing machines. This role will maintain the current customer portfolio, visiting distributors in São Paulo city and supporting clients in other regions remotely. Responsibilities include managing quotes, orders, follow‑ups, and providing inputs for sales forecasting. Later on, the role will also focus on expanding business with existing Singer‑registered dealers, in partnership with the Channel Sales Executives. Responsibilities Manage and support the current customer base, acting as the main contact for maintenance parts orders (quotation, order placement, and follow‑up). Drive sales activities within the existing portfolio. Identify opportunities within the current customer base (Dealers) to expand maintenance parts sales. Conduct proactive outreach and sales initiatives to grow business with existing accounts. Provide accurate information to support sales forecasting and the S&OP process. Negotiate pricing and commercial terms according to established commercial policies. Annual sales volume: R$ 3.5M. Customer base: around 160 direct clients, including 11 distributors (7 located in São Paulo city). Requirements and preferred experience: Bachelor’s degree completed. Previous experience in sales and knowledge of the maintenance parts business is a plus. Knowledge of sales and negotiation techniques. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Languages: Advanced English (mandatory) — ability to operate in a global corporate environment. Intermediate Spanish — to support Latin American operations. Skills, Abilities and knowledge: Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal relationship abilities. Relationship‑driven sales approach, with a strong orientation toward results and portfolio growth. Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team. We offer you: Benefits: medical and life insurance, food basket (or card), canteen at the factory Profit Sharing Program Hybrid work schedule Work environment that harbors a culture of collaboration and community Learning and development opportunities Work Environment / Location / Flexibility SVP Worldwide offers a fast-paced and ever-evolving environment. As part of our Flexible Workplace Policy, this position follows a hybrid work model 3 days per week on-site at our headquarters in Indaiatuba, São Paulo. Why You Will Love Being Part of SVP Worldwide We take care of our team! We offer a competitive benefits package, including multiple healthcare plan options, on-site meals, grocery allowance or meal vouchers, pharmacy benefits, profit sharing, life insurance, and educational partnerships. At SVP Worldwide, we celebrate diversity, equity, and inclusion and strive to build a workforce reflective of our global consumers. This means understanding, respecting, and valuing diverse styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions while being inclusive of all people. SVP Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications. We prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, veteran status, nationality, citizenship, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status. In the News In 2021, SVP Worldwide was acquired by Platinum Equity, a global investment firm with more than $25 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of approximately 50 operating companies serving customers worldwide. Platinum Equity is fully committed to supporting SVP Worldwide’s continued growth by providing additional financial and operational resources to accelerate the company’s efforts.

Our Engineering team helps Nubank to create and use the technology that provides us to build the best financial products.   • Horizontally scalable microservices written mostly in Clojure, using Finagle and leveraging upon functional programming techniques and hexagonal architecture
  • High throughput jobs and inter-service communication using Kafka
  • Continuous Integration and Deployment into AWS

  • Monitoring and observability with Prometheus
  • Running as much as possible in Kubernetes

We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic.   • Write, test, instrument, document, and maintain code. Able to pair and participate in code reviews to contribute to the growth of others in and around the team
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leaders to build new experiences

  • Participate in on-call rotations for your team and respond to incidents as necessary
  • Work focused on backend applications, and be open to contribute to mobile and frontend development, according to business needs

We are looking for a person who has

  • At least 10 years of experience developing digital products in complex environments
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies
  • Proven track record of designing and delivering large-scale systems that serve thousands (or even millions) of users

Ricardo Almeida | Há mais de 40 anos fazendo história na moda nacional.

Com mais de 40 anos de história, a Ricardo Almeida é uma referência na alfaiataria brasileira, sinônimo de elegância, exclusividade e excelência. Vestimos homens e mulheres que buscam transmitir confiança, poder e estilo, unindo tradição e inovação em cada criação.

As peças da marca são desenvolvidas com um acabamento impecável e confeccionadas a partir de tecidos nobres, garantindo não apenas um visual elegante, mas também uma experiência única ao vestir. Acreditamos que cada detalhe importa, e é por isso que nossa dedicação à qualidade e à estética se reflete em tudo que fazemos.

Entre 19 lojas próprias, presença em multimarcas e um espaço em Studio com experiência de compra personalizada, construímos um legado de excelência desde o atendimento até o produto. Estamos em constante evolução, unindo tradição com a tecnologia para reafirmar nossa comunidade e nossos valores.

O que buscamos:

  • Realizar ajustes necessários em peças solicitadas;

  • Garantir que o espaço de trabalho esteja alinhado para a produção da atividade;
  • Preencher diariamente agenda de controle de ajuste de peças;
  • Realizar serviço de passadoria após ajustes ou quando solicitado.

O que esperamos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento de matérias primas e aplicações;

SOMOS O MAIOR ESCRITÓRIO DE ADVOCACIA DO BRASIL! #SOMOSNW

Nelson Wilians Advogados é, atualmente, um dos maiores escritórios de advocacia do Brasil, em número de advogados e capilaridade, com estruturas físicas próprias em todas as capitais e nas principais cidades do interior , esta característica ímpar nos possibilita ter uma atuação jurídica ágil, moderna e eficaz nas mais variadas áreas do Direito. Toda essa estrutura, oferece uma prestação de serviços de qualidade, seja no contencioso de grande escala ou em demandas estratégicas e/ou consultivas. Para nós, cliente bem-sucedido é cliente bem assessorado, por isso resolvemos problemas, gerenciamos riscos e impulsionamos negócios de forma pragmática.

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.

title: Editor Texto e Imagem
description:
Sobre nós

A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

Quais são as funções do cargo?

  • Diagramar provas, simulados e materiais avaliativos conforme identidade visual da instituição.
  • Garantir padronização de estilos, espaçamento, tipografia e hierarquia visual.
  • Preparar arquivos finais para impressão e/ou publicação digital.
  • Realizar ajustes finos em textos, tabelas, imagens e fórmulas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com revisores, designers e autores nos processos de preparação dos instrumentos.
  • Manter e atualizar templates e guias de diagramação.
  • Otimizar processos gráficos visando agilidade e qualidade nas entregas.

O que é preciso para darmos #match

  • Experiência em diagramação editorial, preferencialmente de provas, livros didáticos ou materiais educacionais.
  • Domínio de Adobe InDesign (essencial) e conhecimento de Illustrator, Photoshop e Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento de normas gráficas e boas práticas de editoração.
  • Atenção aos detalhes, senso estético e excelente organização.
  • Capacidade de lidar com prazos curtos e alto volume de materiais.

Aqui, você vai encontrar um espaço acolhedor, que irá dar oportunidade para que você aprenda e se desenvolva! Fazemos isso por meio de um trabalho em equipe harmonioso, que conta com pessoas qualificadas e abertas a ensinar e aprender, buscando sempre obter os melhores resultados para o time!

title: It operations analyst
description:
Company Overview

BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high‑code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning. We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak. With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation.

Role Overview

The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication.

Responsibilities

  • Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools).
  • Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties.
  • Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly.
  • Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing).
  • Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching).
  • Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist).
  • Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues.
  • Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies.
  • Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts).
  • Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).

Requisitos

  • Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree.
  • Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist).
  • Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM).
  • Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow).
  • Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks.
  • Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security.
  • Experience with inventory / asset management systems.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously.
  • Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack.
  • Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team.
  • Portuguese – Fluent.
  • English – Advanced.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks.
  • Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection).
  • Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies.

Employment Details

  • Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level
  • Employment type: Full‑time
  • Job function: Information Technology
  • Industries: Human Resources Services

description:
Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level QA professional to work collaboratively within agile teams, participating from the early stages of the development process and actively contributing to the quality of deliveries. We seek someone who understands that quality is not a final phase, but a continuous part of development.

What you'll do:

  • Act as an Agile QA, participating in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, daily, review, and retrospective).
  • Ensure delivery quality from the requirements-gathering phase (shift-left approach).
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated API tests.
  • Support the team in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression tests.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs in a clear, objective, and prioritized manner.
  • Work collaboratively with developers, product, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s quality processes and practices.

What you'll need:

  • Experience with automated API testing (preferably Rest Assured + Kotlin).
  • Knowledge of BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber).
  • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience in bug management and use of tools such as Jira, Zephyr (or similar).
  • Ability to analyze requirements and identify quality risks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Proactive, organized, and collaborative profile.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with E2E testing or frontend automation.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and test execution in pipelines.
  • Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (performance, security, etc.).
  • Experience with log analysis and support in troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing in mobile or distributed environments.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

  • Days off*

title: Expert Engineer in Verification (UVM/IP/SoC)
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the Search product within the BEES app. Search is a critical capability for BEES, powering most product findability flows and directly impacting GMV across multiple markets. This role sits within the BEES Core team, responsible for building scalable, reliable, and reusable capabilities that serve multiple BEES platforms (Customer, Force, and Link).

You will work closely with engineering, data, design, and multiple product teams to evolve our search algorithms, infrastructure, and user experience, ensuring high performance, reliability, and relevance at scale.

  • Leverage data to drive decisions, using existing dashboards and building new analyses when needed;

  • Collaborate with global stakeholders, presenting updates and insights to senior leadership.

What you'll need

  • University degree in a field related to the role;

  • Strong understanding of search systems, algorithms, or highly scalable backend services (hands-on experience is a plus, but not mandatory);

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;

  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;

  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to support delivery and execution across our Sales Enablement and Frontline experience teams. In this role, you’ll contribute to initiatives that span multiple tools and workflows used by our sales and customer-facing teams. You\'ll work closely with senior PMs, designers, engineers, and go-to-market partners to help scope, prioritize, and deliver features that improve productivity, consistency, and experience across our frontline ecosystem.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on internal tools or platforms, especially for sales or frontline teams
  • Familiarity with sales enablement platforms, CRMs, or customer success tooling
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Exposure to product delivery processes (e.g. agile, sprint planning, release coordination)

More about you

  • You\'re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You\'re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;

Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.
